subject: MAP: Milestone pulse & overdue action summary — ClarityHealth
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Rios <tom.rios@clarityhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & draft MAP — next steps and owners

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time on Friday — good conversation. Per our discovery, I pulled together a short draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have shared milestones, owners, and open dependencies. Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps.

Quick recap from the call:
- Primary goal: pilot Redwood inference for ClarityHealth member routing use case; baseline latency and cost targets agreed.
- Key constraints: PHI handling requirements, evidence for SOC2 controls, and SFTP access to anonymized dataset.

Draft MAP highlights (see attached MAP-v1.2):
- Milestone A — Pilot kickoff (target: 2026-10-18) — Owner: ClarityHealth (Tom Rios) / Redwood onboarding (Ben)
- Milestone B — Data mapping & delivery (target: 2026-10-25) — Owner: ClarityHealth (data team)
- Milestone C — Security & compliance review (target: 2026-10-29) — Owner: ClarityHealth legal + Redwood SecOps (Neha)
- Milestone D — Integration testing (target: 2026-11-05) — Owner: Redwood infra (Marcus)
- Milestone E — Pilot close & evaluation (target close: 2026-11-30) — Joint

Open dependencies:
- ClarityHealth to provide sample dataset (SFTP creds) — blocker for Milestone B
- ClarityHealth legal to confirm scope for handling PHI in pilot — needed for Milestone C
- Redwood to provide ingest template & sample run logs — action: Ben to deliver by 2026-10-09

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Tom / Sara: confirm who will own data mapping and a realistic date for SFTP access (reply to this thread).
2) Legal: if SOC2 evidentiary items need to be shared, point us to the contact (we can produce a short evidence pack).
3) Redwood: Ben will drop the ingest template and example logs into the shared Drive by EOD Friday (10/9).

I've attached MAP-v1.2 (spreadsheet) — we can iterate. If we need to push any dates based on legal timelines, call that out and we'll update the target close.

Thanks —

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: (415) 555-0124
Attachments: MAP-v1.2-clarityhealth.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)

From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@clarityhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Rios <tom.rios@clarityhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & draft MAP — next steps and owners

Thanks Evelyn — helpful summary and appreciate the draft MAP. A few clarifications from our side:

- Legal will need to scope the PHI handling more tightly — likely a short review but I expect ~10 business days (so Milestone C may slip).
- Our data team confirms they can do mapping, but I need to confirm who will be the primary owner for the initial delivery (I can confirm by 10/12).
- Can we move the security review earlier in the sequence (we prefer to get compliance questions resolved before integration testing)?

Also, a heads up: our security team asked for a short evidence pack (SOC2 controls mapping + data retention policy). If Redwood can share a one-page summary, that will speed things up.

Could you upload an updated MAP that reflects: 1) security review moved before integration testing, and 2) a contingency new target close of 2026-12-10 if legal takes the full 10 business days?

Thanks —
Sara Bennett
Director, Digital Platforms | ClarityHealth
Phone: (206) 555-0199

Subject: MAP v1.3 (weekly pulse) — updated owners, overdue tasks, revised targets

Hi all —

Per Sara's note, attached is MAP-v1.3 and a short scope/dependencies PDF. This is the weekly pulse and a short overdue task summary so we can keep the pilot on track.

Summary of changes in v1.3:
- Security review moved before integration testing (Milestone C -> Milestone C1).
- Contingency target close set to 2026-12-10 if legal requires full review window.
- Milestone owner clarifications: Tom confirmed as ClarityHealth primary for Data Mapping (status: open).

Overdue / high-priority items (action required):
- Data mapping deliverable (ClarityHealth, Tom) — target 2026-10-07 (OVERDUE). Please confirm ETA; this is blocking integration testing.
- Ingest template & sample logs (Redwood, Ben) — Ben to deliver by 2026-10-15.
- SOC2 evidence summary (Redwood, Neha) — sent to Sara's security contact (requested today).

Near-term actions / asks:
1) Tom: please confirm a firm ETA for the mapping files or an alternate owner (reply by 10/15).
2) Ben: drop ingest template in the shared folder and flag any sample data size concerns.
3) Sara: let us know if we should schedule a short working session with security to walk through the evidence pack.

If the data mapping doesn't land by 10/15, we will need to shift integration testing and the pilot close to the contingency date (2026-12-10). I'm attaching MAP-v1.3 and scope-deps-20261012.pdf.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (CLH-2026-0423)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-example

Thanks —

Subject: Re: MAP v1.3 (weekly pulse) — updated owners, overdue tasks, revised targets

Thanks Evelyn — I apologize for the delay on the mapping files. I will take ownership and get a first drop by Friday 10/15 EOD. If we run into any blockers I'll loop in our data lead and flag here.

We are okay with the updated sequence and contingency date for now — let's keep the weekly pulse cadence and we can escalate if legal pushes beyond the 10 business days.

Tom Rios
Senior Manager, Data Engineering | ClarityHealth
